Alex — thanks, this is helpful. A few quick datapoints from our side: 

- Expected attendee list is ~28 (12 execs + 16 product/eng). There will be a small contingent from procurement who need to review retention and data flow notes.
- AV/security: our SSO team requests that any external laptop connections go through the guest VLAN (they require an on-site auth token). I attached our vendor requirements — stellare_vendor_reqs.pdf.
- Catering: 2 vegetarian + 1 gluten-free per 10 headcount; we'll coordinate final numbers next Monday.

For the run-of-show, could we tighten the demo slot to 25m + 10m Q/A to leave more time for the integration breakout? Also is there a one-page preread we can send to execs that frames the business outcomes?

Happy to jump on a 20m sync if helpful.

Best,
Laura
